messages.author: 0c9494c71e4410b8
messages.subject: "Error in Connection" — Simple Question
parts:
Hi —

I am relatively new to using Shiny. I set up a very basic app that is basically a replica of one of the examples on the Shiny site's gallery — it produces a basic bar plot. 
  • It runs well in RStudio.
  • When I use deployApp(), it says "Application successfully deployed" and gives the URL
  • When I go to that URL, I see "ERROR: cannot open the connection"
It seems this should be a relatively simple problem to solve but I am sure I am missing something. Help?

Cynthia

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: "Error in Connection" — Simple Question
parts:
Typical that means that the app can't find the file you're trying to open. You should make sure any data files you're referencing are in the same directory (or subdirectory) of your application files.

For example:

myapp/server.R
myapp/ui.R
myapp/my-data.CSV

-Andy
